response.sql: WITH c AS (SELECT player_id, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM manager_award WHERE player_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY player_id), t AS (SELECT SUM(cnt) AS total FROM c) SELECT c.player_id, c.cnt AS award_count, CAST(c.cnt AS REAL) / t.total AS fraction FROM c CROSS JOIN t WHERE t.total IS NOT NULL ORDER BY fraction DESC, c.player_id LIMIT 10

assumptions.assumption: Rows with a NULL player_id are excluded, since they cannot be attributed to a player. The total is the sum of per-player counts, so it equals the number of non-null-player records.
Ties in the fraction are broken by player_id ascending, so the top 10 is deterministic.
